PURPOSE

Make discourse order, narrated order, and recall/interview context legible while preserving the provider's actual chronology contract. A flashback must be visible as a crossing or equivalent structural event; the view must not manufacture a total order when only a partial order exists.

SCOPE AND ACCEPTANCE

- Consume provider-supplied chronology/order relations, uncertainty, missingness, and evidence; do no temporal inference in StoryAtlas.
- Draw the three clocks or explicitly unavailable clocks with distinct structural labels and non-colour encodings.
- Render at least one provider-authored flashback/crossing case and one ambiguous or partial-order case.
- Any device-only placement is declared non-metric and cannot feed identity, selection, ordering, or another projection.
- Endpoint identities, crossings, alternatives, off-projection states, evidence descent, and requested-layer disposition remain inspectable in the static preview and interactive app.
- Mutation tests prove that changing provider order/uncertainty changes the appropriate marks and that reordering input serialization alone does not invent chronology.
- Keyboard, textual-twin, 200 percent zoom, computed contrast/non-colour, deterministic receipt, and DPR 2 browser courts pass.

2026-09-22 WORKSPACE DESIGN CATALOG
Governing implementation design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md; granular crosswalk is section 10.3. Live Mote owns status. Existing scientific/static acceptance remains in force.
This remains a separate existing capability/contract; no dependency on the full four-screen completion gate is introduced and it does not become a new M1 prerequisite.
